"use client"; import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import Link from 'next/link'; import { useAuth } from '@/lib/auth-context'; import { useLanguage } from '@/lib/language-context'; import { apiRequest } from '@/lib/api'; import { Sprout, TrendingUp, MapPin, Compass, CloudSun, ShieldCheck, AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, Plus, Bell, CheckCircle2, Calendar, Layers, Sparkles, Calculator } from 'lucide-react'; interface DashboardData { farmer_profile: { id: string; farmer_id: string; full_name: string; phone_number: string; state?: string; district?: string; village?: string; pincode?: string; }; total_farms: number; total_acreage: number; total_crops: number; crops_by_status: Record; unread_notifications_count: number; active_price_alerts_count: number; recommended_action_summary?: string; } export default function DashboardPage() { const { user, profile, token, loginDemo } = useAuth(); const { t } = useLanguage(); const [data, setData] = useState(null); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); useEffect(() => { const fetchDashboard = async () => { try { const res = await apiRequest('/farmer/dashboard'); setData(res); } catch (err) { // Fallback default state setData({ farmer_profile: { id: profile?.id || 'demo-id', farmer_id: profile?.farmer_id || 'AGRI-8N4K-3M9Q', full_name: profile?.full_name || 'Ramesh Patil', phone_number: profile?.phone_number || '+919876543210', state: 'Maharashtra', district: 'Nashik', village: 'Lasalgaon', pincode: '422306', }, total_farms: 1, total_acreage: 4.5, total_crops: 2, crops_by_status: { "Growing": 1, "Ready to Harvest": 1, "Stored": 0, "Partially Sold": 0, "Completed": 0, }, unread_notifications_count: 1, active_price_alerts_count: 1, recommended_action_summary: "Favorable window to SELL Onion at Pimpalgaon Baswant APMC (Net Realization ₹2,409.80/Qtl).", }); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; fetchDashboard(); }, [profile]); if (!user && !profile) { return (
